name: YooAnalytics – Privacy-Friendly Analytics for WordPress & WooCommerce (Google Analytics Alternative)
author: YooAnalytics

sections.description:
✨ Upgrade to Pro 👑 | [🚀 Just Install & Use – No Setup Needed]

YooAnalytics is a privacy-friendly, self-hosted analytics plugin for WordPress and WooCommerce – a lightweight alternative to Google Analytics.
It gives you full control of your website data without relying on third-party servers.

With YooAnalytics, you can easily monitor real-time visitors, page views, traffic sources, WooCommerce purchase events, checkout journeys, referrers, and search engine traffic – all inside your WordPress dashboard.

Perfect for site owners who want accurate website & store insights without sacrificing privacy, speed, or control.

📊 Key Features – Analytics for WordPress & WooCommerce

  • WordPress widget added for at-a-glance stats
  • Real-Time Visitor Tracking – see who’s online now
  • UTM Parameters Tracking – monitor your campaigns – Upgrade to Pro
  • Visitors & Page Views Tracking
  • Online Users Monitoring
  • WooCommerce Purchase Events Tracking
  • WooCommerce Checkout Funnel (coming soon)
  • Traffic Sources & Referrers
  • Search Engine Referrers
  • Top 10 Referrers Overview
  • Instant Auto-Refresh
  • Filterable Stats
  • Interactive Bar & Line Charts
  • Weekly Email Performance Report

🌍 Geolocation & Countries (Coming Soon)

  • Track visitors by country

🛒 Complete WooCommerce Checkout & Purchase Journey (Coming Soon)

  • Track checkout steps & conversion drop-offs
  • See the full purchase journey

✅ Why Choose YooAnalytics?

  • 100% privacy-friendly – data stored in your own WordPress database
  • No external accounts needed
  • Works instantly – just install & activate
  • Designed for WordPress & WooCommerce
  • Lightweight & optimized for speed
sections.faq:
Where is my analytics data stored?

All data is stored locally in your own WordPress database. No external servers.

Do I need to create an account?

No, YooAnalytics works out of the box – no account or third-party setup required.

Are there any tracking limits?

No, you can track unlimited visitors, page views, and WooCommerce events.
